class.name: WeatherRunoff3D
class.brief_description: Rain running off the land over kilometres: where it flows, how much, and how deep.
class.description: A grid round its position over the terrain's heights: depressions filled (Priority-Flood, Barnes et al. 2014), each cell draining to its steepest neighbour (D8), the share of [method WeatherMap3D.get_ground_water_input_at] that runs off by the SCS curve number, routed as linear reservoirs at TR-55 overland and Leopold and Maddock channel speeds. [PhysXRiver3D] and lakes read its discharge to rise in rain, and [WeatherMap3D] wets the ground the runoff flows over. See docs/ideas/rain.md.

method.name: advance
method.description: Steps the runoff [param seconds] on, with the weather's water input.

method.name: bake
method.description: Samples the heights and builds the drainage network.

method.name: channel_velocity
method.description: Leopold and Maddock (1953) mean channel speed (m/s) for [param discharge] m³/s.

method.name: get_bake_time_msec
method.description: How long the last bake took.

method.name: get_depth_at
method.description: The water held over the cell at [param position], in mm.

method.name: get_discharge_at
method.description: The flow (m³/s) leaving the cell at [param position].

method.name: get_map_rect
method.description: The grid's rect in world x and z.

method.name: get_max_discharge_in
method.description: The largest flow (m³/s) leaving any cell in [param rect].

method.name: get_total_storage
method.description: The water (m³) held on the grid.

method.name: get_upstream_area_at
method.description: The area (m²) draining through the cell at [param position].

method.name: scs_runoff
method.description: The SCS curve number runoff (mm) from [param rain_mm] of rain.

method.name: shallow_flow_velocity
method.description: TR-55 shallow concentrated flow speed (m/s, unpaved) on a [param slope] (rise over run).
